name: Your First Riding Kodo
summary: A kodo awaits your choice. Your decision begins a journey with a dependable companion.

sections.title: Choosing a Kodo
sections.body: A kodo is offered to you as a companion for travel. Examine the riding kodos and choose the one that feels right to you.

sections.title: A New Companion
sections.body: Once you have chosen, the kodo is provided to you. The hope is that you will care for one another, with the Earthmother guiding you both.

faq.q: What am I being asked to do?
faq.answer: Examine the riding kodos and choose one as your first mount.
Kodos are described as dependable companions that are slow to anger.

faq.q: Can I choose whichever kodo I like?
faq.answer: You are encouraged to choose the kodo that speaks to you.
The chosen kodo is provided to you as your companion.

attribution: In-game quest text: Your First Riding Kodo
